author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Of all the incredible props from Blade Runner 2049, the one Adam is drawn to the most is the Memory Orb device used by Dr. Stelline to construct memories for replicants. This one of a kind hand prop is actually a functional animatronic, with a complex mechanical system that animates its layers of machined rings. Adam and Propstore's Brandon Alinger take a look at how the device works and find details that were never shown on screen. 

Learn more about these props and see the full catalog at Propstore: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/536

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
